notes.title: Demo update 0.5.2072
notes.notes:
[p]UPDATE 0.5.2072[/p][list][*][p][b]Inventory & UI:[/b] Lots of polish — clearer durability bars, better item assignment, refreshed item details, shop buttons fixed, and overall cleaner HUD.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Fishing mechanics:[/b] Improved rod physics, lure animations, drag calculations, and fish-catching logic. Casting, reeling, and line tension now feel more natural.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Multiplayer:[/b] Big step forward! Added synchronization for rods, reels, bobbers, lures, fish fights, avatars, and boats. Chat, lobby features, quick join, and Steam relay connections are now integrated. Fish positions, weights, and catches sync properly across players.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Audio & visuals:[/b] New fishing sounds, reel effects, lure animations, and camera improvements. Optimized shadows, fog, and underwater camera behavior.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Bugs & fixes:[/b] Tons of reported issues resolved (naming errors, UI overlaps, input bugs, fish stamina, item assignment quirks, and more). Stability improved across both singleplayer and multiplayer.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Minor details:[/b] Added weight scale when holding fish, improved menu performance, clearer tooltips, crown icons for lobby leaders, boat collisions, and multiple boat spawn spots.[/p][/*][/list][hr][/hr][h2]🎣 A note from the devs[/h2][p]This was a [b]huge wave of updates[/b], focused on making fishing smoother, multiplayer more fun, and the game world more alive. We’ve fixed a lot of long-standing issues and added features that should make both solo fishing and multiplayer sessions much more enjoyable.[/p][p]As always, your feedback is super valuable. Please keep testing, reporting, and sharing your thoughts. You’re helping shape the game into something really special! 💙[/p][hr][/hr][h2]⚠️ Known Issues[/h2][list][*][p]We’re still [b]not fully happy with performance[/b] — it should already feel a bit better, but we’ll continue optimizing.[/p][/*][*][p]The [b]drag system[/b] isn’t quite where we want it yet, more improvements are coming.[/p][/*][*][p]Please remember to [b]report bugs through the in-game bug reporter[/b] — it helps us a ton in tracking down issues.[/p][/*][/list][hr][/hr][p]
[/p]

notes.title: Update 0.4.1719
notes.notes:
[p][b]🛠 Changelog[/b]
• Fixed  issue where control settings (camera sensitivity, inverted axes) reset after reopening the options menu.
• Fixed jittering of fishing line and rod during precise cast.
• Added length data to rods.
• Corrected hook sizes.
• Fixed Zoom hotkey being visible.
• Improved player exiting water behavior.
• Fixed boat controls — the boat now stops when the player is not seated.
• Added day time change (T key).
• Added lights to the boat (F key).
• Fixed lure sizes.
• Improved third-person camera — switching cameras now resets properly.
• Fixed fish controller glitch when fish was looping out of water.
• Fixed reeling and pumping rod animations.
• Reworked day / night visual[/p][hr][/hr][p]Thank you to everyone who provided feedback and understood that this is an early demo version. A lot will still change before the full release, and many new features will be added that have never been seen before in the UFS series. See you in the next demo update![/p]

notes.title: Update 0.4.1675
notes.notes: [p][b]Update 0.4.1675[/b][/p][p]• Added reel/drag percentage notification label.[/p][p]• Fixed issue where, after the line was fully unrolled, the tension still respected the drag setting.[/p][p]• Fish now attack baits more slowly.[/p][p]• Added fish size attribute to lure compatibility.[/p][p]• Fixed issue where the hook was invisible.[/p][p]• Improved precision rod casting.[/p][p]• Fixed bug where precision rod casting couldn't be cancelled by right-clicking during the casting state.[/p][p]• Improved player swimming movement.[/p][p]• Added new hook types.[/p][p]• Fixed issue where unequipping gear didn’t reset ground placement settings.[/p]
